explanation: The two-job execution is faulty because the top-level corpus includes qualifying record n06-r01 with demand_score 9, but Job 2 received needs and evidence_sources handoffs starting at n06-r02 and omitting n06-r01. The downstream output is consistent with the incomplete handoffs it received, so the fault localizes upstream.
